source: Requested customer-offer and number lesson, continued with discounts
lessonTheme: Discount percentages and a complete two-sentence offer
summary: Explained percentage components after diez veinte was combined for 20%. Trecento for 30 corrected to treinta; focused and full retry retained treinta. Discuento recurred twice, then final price 250 euros plus discount 20% was entirely correct, including descuento spelling. Sí, claro accent supplied separately.

observations.learnerText: El descuento es del diez veinte por ciento
observations.correctedText: El descuento es del veinte por ciento.
observations.outcome: Combined diez and veinte for requested 20%. Asked whether del diez por ciento was the percentage. Tutor separated diez=10, veinte=20, por ciento=percent and explained del = de + el in this discount pattern.
Affirmative meaning understood; accent on sí and punctuation supplied. No independent accented retry.

observations.learnerText: el discuento es del trecento por ciento
observations.correctedText: El descuento es del treinta por ciento.
observations.outcome: Es del ... por ciento structure correct. Discuento corrected to descuento; trecento corrected to treinta. Contrasted treinta=30 and trescientos=300.
Correct focused immediate retry after treinta model; not independent delayed recall.

observations.learnerText: El discuento es del treinta por ciento
observations.correctedText: El descuento es del treinta por ciento.
observations.outcome: Treinta por ciento correct in full sentence; discuento recurred. Descuento corrected again with des-cuen-to spelling breakdown.

observations.learnerText: El precio es de doscientos cincuenta euros. El descuento es del veinte por ciento.
observations.correctedText: El precio es de doscientos cincuenta euros. El descuento es del veinte por ciento.
observations.outcome: Both requested sentences correct. Recalled price 250 after intervening material, used veinte for 20%, and retained corrected descuento spelling. Immediate lesson transfer, not long-term mastery.

nextSteps: Recall the complete 250-euro/20% offer after a gap.
Review descuento spelling, treinta versus trescientos and one number before por ciento.
Continue earlier cien/ciento, seiscientos and setecientos recall; immediate success is not long-term mastery.
assessmentNote: Final combined offer correct after explanations and intervening practice; no long-term retention assessment.
